questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Cobras?
At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 136, against Knights on 2025/11/02.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Dolphins?
At Polokwane Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Khushi Mistry holds it with 19, a joint record shared with Thembi Mokgohloa.

questions.question: Which of these players is tied for the most provincial unions represented in a career in this database, having played for five?
questions.explanation: Janse van Rensburg played for Dolphins, Dragons, Eastern Storm, Knights and Limpopo Lillies, five unions. She's tied for the database record alongside Zizipho Mdebuka, Bernadine Bezuidenhout and Alysia Rudolph.

questions.question: At which ground did Angel Mgwenya record their career-best innings (40*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Uplands College, against Dragons on 2024/03/10.
